name: Unspeakable Forbiddance
body:
Price 6,600 gp; Slot —; CL 11th; Weight —; Aura moderate enchantment

DESCRIPTION

A creature that wears or wields this item is compelled not to speak, write, communicate, or even think the name of the item’s creator until the curse is removed. Each time the cursed creature answers a question or provides information or clues or otherwise alludes to the creator’s identity, the cursed creature must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or suffer the same ill effects as if she had failed to comply with a geas/quest or mark of justice spell (depending on which spell was used in the item’s creation).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,300 gp; Spells bestow curse, geas/quest or mark of justice
